details.text: A highly localized favorable corridor for supercell intensification and a brief tornado and damaging wind gusts may persist for another hour or so

details.label: Discussion
details.text: A weak, semi-discrete supercell structure is tracking eastward across parts of northeastern MN, with access to warm/unstable inflow to its southeast. Trailing cells and associated outflow are approaching this storm from the west. This could support a constructive cell interaction and brief intensification of the supercell as it continues eastward for the next 30 min to an hour -- before being undercut by the outflow. This could support a locally favorable risk for a brief tornado and damaging wind gusts

mesoscaleDiscussions.summary: Increasing threat for severe storms by late afternoon. A watch is possible

details.label: Summary
details.text: Increasing threat for severe storms by late afternoon. A watch is possible

details.label: Discussion
details.text: Easterly upslope flow across western NE/KS into eastern Colorado to the foothills is contributing to steadily increasing moisture into eastern Colorado/southeastern Wyoming. Recent ACARS soundings from DEN show MLCIN remains. MLCAPE around 1000-2000 J/kg is noted within SPC Mesoanalysis from eastern Colorado into western Nebraska/northern Kansas. Convection has increased along the high terrain. Guidance suggests that with further heating and forcing for ascent with an upstream disturbance shifting eastward late this afternoon/early evening, thunderstorms will increase in coverage spread into the lower plains in eastern Colorado and eventually into portions of the central Plains. With modest westerly flow aloft and deep layer shear around 30-35 kts, supercell modes will be favored initially. Large hail and severe gusts will be the primary threat, given steep low to mid-level lapse rates and aforementioned thermodynamic environment. A transition to clusters and upscale growth though the evening with severe gusts becoming the primary threat through the evening. A watch will be possible this evening to cover this potential
